raw.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

This role offers location flexibility and is open to candidates across the United States.

Candidates based in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) area will be hired in a hybrid capacity and are expected to work onsite at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in‑office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities.

About the Role:

TheSr. Director,Segment Strategy –Supply Chain Operationsserves as a senior individual contributor within the North America Pharmaceutical Distribution Strategy function, supporting theSupply Chain Operations(SCO)segment.SCOrepresentsMcKesson's robust supply chain,distribution operations,and dedicated customer support teams,includingover 6,000 highly skilled associates.Reporting to the VP,Segment Strategy, this positionoperatesas a lead strategic partner to segment leadership.

The Senior Directoris responsible forowning and leading defined workstreams and strategic sub-areas within the segment, shaping insights, framing decisions, and driving forward progress in close partnership with business and functional leaders. This is a highly hands-on role that requires strong judgment in stakeholder engagement and a commitment to developing strategy collaboratively—not in isolation.

Success in this role is defined by the ability to translate complex dynamics into actionable decisions, build credibility with partners, and ensure strategic work leads to practical, executable outcomes.

What You'll Do:

Strategic Initiative Leadership

  • Lead strategic initiatives end-to-end — from problem definition and workplan design through analysis, recommendation development, syndication, and hand-off to execution owners.

  • Structure ambiguous, contested problems into clear hypotheses, workplans, and decision paths; insist on clear problem definition, logic, and evidence.

  • Develop recommendations that reflect genuine choices with explicit trade-offs — not lists of initiatives — and that are grounded in the financial architecture of the relevant market.

  • Prepare and run productive problem-solving sessions with business partners; engage stakeholders in joint problem solving rather than delivering conclusions to them.

Value Chain Economics & Financial Analysis

  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource on the financial architecture of the pharmaceutical value chain — how manufacturers, distributors, PBMs, payers, and pharmacies generate and protect economic value, and how those mechanisms are beingrepriced.

  • Direct and quality-control the financial models built by theteam;ensure every significant analysisidentifiesthe assumptions that matter most and translates market shifts into quantified P&L implications.

  • Analyze the second-order financial and competitive consequences of legislative and regulatory developments — drug pricing reform, PBM transparency, reimbursementpolicy — within the scope of assigned initiatives.

  • Contribute to scenario analysis of vertical integration, direct channel development, and disintermediation moves by value chain participants.

Thought Partnership & Syndication

  • Act as a credible thought partner to business leaders within the scope of assigned initiatives; challenge assumptions constructively and surface inconvenient facts early.

  • Understand the organization’s culture and individual stakeholderperspectives, andconsider them in crafting recommendations that the business canactually execute.

  • Develop thoughtful plans to engage stakeholders through the process — from fact-finding to solution development — to build alignment as the work proceeds, not after it concludes.

Communication

  • Deliver compelling written and oral communications to senior business audiences; lead with key messages, present persuasively and with conviction, and tailor materials to the audience.

  • Ask powerful, open-ended questions; actively listen and respond to nuance and mood in senior settings.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Partner with and direct teams of one to three Senior Managers and analysts per initiative; scopeworkrealistically against team capacity and deliver high-quality output without undue crunch.

  • Coach team members in astrengths-based way; provide insightful,timelyfeedback; shape step-up opportunities that stretch colleagues.

  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive team climate and to function-building efforts including recruiting and knowledge development.

Execution Support

  • Translate approved recommendations intoimplementationroadmaps with clear owners, milestones, and metrics; support transformation programs through their early execution phases.

  • Create feedback loops that surface early execution signals back intothe strategiclogic.

BasicRequirements:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, including engagement-leadership experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm or equivalent project-leadership experience in a corporate strategy function.

  • 5+ years of experience in distributionsupply chain; strong preference for pharmaceutical and/or healthcaredistributionexperience.

  • Demonstrated ability to build working fluency in complex value chain economics quickly.

  • Track recordof leading cross-functional strategic projects end-to-end that resulted in concrete decisions and measurable action — not just analysis delivered to others.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop small analytical teams.

  • Executive presence anddemonstratedeffectivenesspresenting toand influencing senior leaders.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Problem Framer:Structures problems soundly using core problem-solving disciplines; translates ambiguity into hypotheses, workplans, and decision paths; embraces qualitative, people, and relationship-based problem solving alongside the quantitative.

  • Value Chain Fluency:Possessesworking knowledge of pharmaceutical value chain economics — distribution margin structures, sourcing dynamics, PBM and payer economics, and pharmacy P&Ls — and applies it as a core analytical lens, not background knowledge.

  • Recommendation Craft:Synthesizes complete sets of implications into well-syndicated recommendations framed as genuine choices with explicit trade-offs; controls quality and process across the initiative.

  • Constructive Challenger:Challengesstakeholderand team assumptionsconstructively;bringsnew insights;is developingthe trust-based relationships that makechallengewelcome rather thanresisted.

  • People Developer:Coaches team members in astrengths-based way,solicitsfeedback, and creates the conditions for high performance and team health.

  • Communication:Prepares well-structured documents with minimal guidance; presents well to audiences of all sizes; fosters constructive dialogue and balances asking with telling.

Physical Requirements:

  • General office demands

  • Must have the ability to travel up to 20%of the time

  • Candidate within 50 miles of Irving, TX will be required to be onsite 2 days per week.

McKesson complies with all applicable U.S. immigration laws and regulations. The Company does not provide employer support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment benefit for this role.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis without the need for employer support or sponsorship now or in the future. This includes having the legal right to work in the United States without the need for McKesson support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment authorization (e.g., H1B, O1, E3, H1B1, TN, F1 OPT, F1 STEM OPT, F1 CPT, etc.) now or in the future.

If you will require McKesson to provide immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future, you should not apply for this position.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend

We’re looking for Senior Backend Engineers who care about building scalable, reliable systems - and who thrive in a collaborative environment. You’ll join one of several product or infrastructure teams, each tackling challenges from decisioning to payments to APIs. Wherever you land, you’ll work on projects that are high-impact, technically challenging, and deeply rewarding.

Tilt is a remote-first company. We drive connectivity through regular company offsites. Travel for company offsites is expected at a minimum 2 times a year.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Design and scale backend systems that power our consumer facing products

  • Build and refine APIs that deliver instant, seamless experiences.

  • Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support, and analytics teams.

  • Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and roadmap planning.

  • Drive continuous improvement in code quality, security, and operational excellence.

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to engineering best practices.

Why You’re a Great Fit

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience (we know careers don’t all look the same — if you’re close, let’s talk).

  • Experience with .NET (C#), or similar frameworks

  • Experience scaling consumer-facing products with significant transaction volumes

  • A collaborative problem-solver who values inclusion, feedback, and continuous learning.

  • Able to effectively leverage AI-powered development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment, Factory) to enhance productivity, code quality, and collaboration

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $170,850 - $201,000

the company

UniAdmissions (www.uniadmissions.co.uk) is a leading provider of premium educational services and the world’s foremost Oxbridge admissions consultancy. In 2024, 67% of our students secured Oxbridge offers, compared to a national average of 18%.


We are at the forefront of a new generation of educational support, combining academic excellence with a highly personalised approach.


In 2023, UniAdmissions became part of the Testbusters group, a fast-growing international education and EdTech scale-up. Together, we are building a group that brings together excellence, accessibility, and innovation across multiple markets.

the role

As Head of Agent Relationships – Asia, you will report directly to the Managing Director and lead our partnerships with education agents across Asia, with a particular focus on the China market — turning potential leads into valued, long-term relationships and hitting your sales targets consistently.


You will take charge of this high-potential, underdeveloped area of our business: expanding our network of trusted agents, refining partnership strategy, and owning the full B2B sales cycle from first contact through to closing and account growth. This is a hands-on role with a clear mandate to build and scale our Asia agent network over the next 12–24 months.


We are looking for a commercially driven, ambitious individual with strong relationship-building skills and a bias for action. You will represent the business externally, lead partner conversations across time zones and cultures, and ensure we consistently convert opportunities into long-term, high-value relationships.

In this role you will be involved in all aspects of our B2B business, dealing with agents, strategic partners and much more:

  • Take ownership of our agent business across Asia — creating and implementing the strategy for this area, with a focus on China.

  • Take full accountability for achieving and exceeding your quarterly and annual sales targets.

  • Map out, prospect, and close new agents and partnership opportunities to expand our network.

  • Deal with inbound B2B enquiries and convert them into paying clients.

  • Tailor pitches to address the needs of agent and corporate partners.

  • Host webinars for agents.

  • Carry out consultations with students who come through these agents.

  • Prepare quotes and proposals for prospective students.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, including negotiations, and build long-term client relationships.

  • Follow up with leads to ensure you consistently meet your sales quota.

  • Attend weekly sales coaching sessions and receive formal training.

  • Collaborate with the Programme Managers to ensure all business clients receive exceptional service.

what we are looking for

Must have

  • A degree from a UK university in any discipline.

  • Good knowledge of the Chinese and/or wider Asian education/agent market.

  • Fluency in Mandarin and English (written and spoken).

  • Demonstrable experience in a sales or partnership development role, ideally in a B2B or education setting.

  • Commercial mindset with clear ownership of targets and revenue outcomes.

  • Analytical approach, comfortable using CRM systems and sales data

  • Strong collaboration skills and willingness to challenge constructively

  • Familiarity with UK higher education and admissions processes

Nice to have

  • An existing network of education agents in China or Asia.

  • Experience in education, tutoring, EdTech, or similar service-based sectors.

  • Experience scaling or managing a partnerships function.

  • Experience in high-ticket or consultative sales.

  • Familiarity with UK higher education and admissions processes.

  • Degree from Oxford or Cambridge (advantageous, not required).

what we offer

  • Growth and progression — This role offers a clear path to senior leadership. As the Asia function scales, there is potential to grow into a broader regional commercial role. You will initially operate in a highly hands-on capacity while building a more structured network.

  • Compensation — Base salary: £45,000, plus an uncapped, performance-related bonus tied to sales.

  • Working structure — Full-time, two-year fixed-term role. Primarily remote, with in-person company training days approximately once per month. Travel across Asia (particularly China) as required.

recruitment process

Following initial screening and interviews, candidates will be asked to complete an assessment. This will be followed by a two-stage interview process:

  • Preliminary interview

  • Advanced interview focused on practical execution, including a business case presentation to senior leadership

  • Values and Behaviours interview, focused on alignment and ways of working

raw.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on training optimization to help us push the efficiency, stability, and scalability of large-scale model training. You’ll work at the intersection of research and systems, developing novel techniques to reduce training cost, accelerate convergence, and improve model quality—while validating ideas through rigorous experiments and publications.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning research insights into practical training wins, and who has a track record (or strong ambition) of publishing applied ML research.

What You’ll Work On

  • Design and evaluate training optimization techniques for large models (e.g. optimization algorithms, schedulers, normalization, curriculum strategies)

  • Improve training efficiency and stability across long runs and large datasets

  • Research and implement methods such as:

    • Optimizer and scheduler innovations

    • Mixed-precision, low-precision, and memory-efficient training

    • Gradient noise reduction, scaling laws, and convergence analysis

    • Training-time regularization and robustness techniques

  • Run large-scale experiments, analyze results, and translate findings into actionable improvements

  • Author or co-author research papers, technical reports, or blog posts

  • Collaborate closely with infrastructure and inference teams to ensure training decisions translate to real-world performance

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning research, with emphasis on training dynamics and optimization

  • Experience training large neural networks (LLMs, multimodal models, or large sequence models)

  • Publication experience in ML venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM, arXiv) or equivalent high-quality open research

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Optimization theory and practice

    • Backpropagation, gradient flow, and training stability

    • Distributed and large-batch training

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: At least 3+ years of experience in media buying, with a strong focus on search arbitrage and performance-driven campaigns.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical abilities with experience in evaluating performance metrics, KPIs, and optimizing based on data-driven insights.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses: Attractive salary with performance-based bonuses that reward results.

raw.description:
Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for a Hospital Privileging Specialist to join our team. Pediatrix Medical Group is a physician lead organization, and we are one of the nation’s largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services. We are seeking someone with hands-on experience obtaining hospital privileges for physicians and advanced practice providers.

Talented business professionals from diverse backgrounds choose Pediatrix because we are an exciting and innovative company that focuses on a team approach to improve the lives of patients everywhere. We offer a diverse range of opportunities, competitive salaries and benefits, and a commitment to clinical excellence, we are confident that you'll love being a part of the Pediatrix team.

Responsibilities

The Privileging Specialist completes and processes hospital privilege applications and provides follow-up to ensure clinician is privileged to start on proposed target start date.

  • Process hospital privilege applications on behalf of new and existing clinicians as needed
  • Communicates on a regular basis with the medical staff offices to obtain status updates
  • Maintains and updates credentialing database with status and necessary data elements
  • Documents all tasks, phone calls, emails and other forms of communication during the credentialing process in the database
  • Conducts written and verbal follow up to determine application status
  • Escalates all issues to the appropriate members of management staff, region, and/or internal clinical onboarding team as necessary
  • Responds promptly to all questions, received via phone or email, regarding privileges
  • Communicates with all necessary internal departments as needed
  • Develops and maintains good relationships with medical staff offices
  • Participates in divisional huddle meetings
  • Completes other tasks or projects as assigned

Qualifications

Experience/Education:

Two (2) years related privileging experience in healthcare.

Knowledge/Skills:

  • Knowledge of Medical processes (credentialing and privileges)
  • Superior customer service skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Organization and the ability to multi-task
  • Diplomatic problem-solving skills
  • Strong Interpersonal skills
  • Ability to facilitate open dialogue to explore underlying problems
  • Ability to quickly change and adapt to new priorities
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Ability to work well under pressure, managing critical deadlines

Software:

Proficiency with Outlook, Word, Excel, Business Database

Benefits and Compensation

Take great care of the patient, every day and every way.TM At Pediatrix & Obstetrix, that’s not only our motto at work each day; it’s also how we view our employees and their families. We know that our greatest asset is YOU.

We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that fit your life and lifestyle, supporting your health and overall well-being. Benefits offered include, but are not limited to: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA and HSAs, as well as a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Some benefits are provided at no cost, while others require a cost share between employees and the company. Employees may also select voluntary plans and pay for these benefits through convenient payroll deductions. Our benefit programs are just one of the many ways Pediatrix & Obstetrix helps our employees take care of themselves and their families.

About Us

Pediatrix Medical Group is one of the nation’s leading providers of highly specialized health care for women, babies and children. Since 1979, Pediatrix has grown from a single neonatology practice to a national, multispecialty medical group. Pediatrix-affiliated clinicians are committed to providing coordinated, compassionate and clinically excellent services to women, babies and children across the continuum of care, both in hospital settings and office-based practices. The group’s high-quality, evidence-based care is bolstered by significant investments in research, education, quality-improvement and safety initiatives.

We're looking for a strategic, results-oriented Senior Field Marketing Manager to lead the marketing strategy for our North America Financial Services business. This role is responsible for driving pipeline and revenue growth across priority accounts through integrated, account-based experiences aligned to sales strategy.

As the marketing lead for the Financial Services segment in North America, you'll partner closely with Sales, Sales Development, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Partner and RevOps to develop and execute data-driven GTM plans that influence every stage of the customer journey. The ideal candidate is highly organized, manages multiple stakeholders with ease, has a strong understanding of complex sales motions, and a passion for connecting marketing investments to pipeline and revenue impact.

Measurement and Performance Management

Job Description Summary

‎

Mosaic Health is seeking a Manager of Clinical Applications responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, optimization, support, and governance of clinical software applications across the organization.

This role leads a team of clinical application analysts and specialists working collaboratively with clinical leaders, information technology, and operational departments to ensure technology solutions effectively support patient care, regulatory compliance, and organizational objectives.

The Manager serves as the primary liaison between clinical operations and IT, ensuring that clinical applications are reliable, secure, user-friendly, and aligned with best practices in healthcare technology across Mosaic, CareMore, Vera Whole Health, and Millennium.

The Manager of Clinical Applications is expected to possess a strong technical foundation in healthcare applications and supporting technologies, enabling effective collaboration with clinical, infrastructure, cybersecurity, integration, and vendor teams. This role applies technical knowledge to support implementation, optimization, lifecycle management, interoperability, and ongoing performance of enterprise clinical systems while ensuring alignment with organizational strategy, regulatory requirements, and best practices.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Clinical Application Analystsand Specialists.

  • Establish departmental goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.

  • Manage staffing, scheduling, workload prioritization, and budget responsibilities.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Clinical Applications Management

  • Oversee the implementation, maintenance, enhancement, and support of clinical applications including Electronic Health Records (EHR), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), Radiology Information Systems (RIS), Pharmacy systems, and other clinical technologies.

  • Develop andmaintainapplication roadmaps aligned with organizational strategy.

  • Ensure system availability, performance, and reliability.

  • Coordinate application upgrades, patches, testing, and releases.

  • Manageapplicationlifecycle planning and vendor relationships.

Project Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional implementation and optimization projects.

  • Coordinate project timelines, resource allocation, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication.

  • Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.

  • Participate in organizational strategic planning initiatives involving clinical technology.

ClinicalWorkflowOptimization

  • Partner with physicians, nurses, ancillary departments, and operational leaders to improve workflows through technology.

  • Analyze clinical processes and recommend application enhancements.

  • Promotetheadoption of evidence-based workflows and standardized documentation.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure clinical applicationscomply withregulatory requirements including HIPAA, CMS, Joint Commission, and applicable state and federal regulations.

  • Support cybersecurity initiatives related to clinical systems.

  • Develop policies, procedures, and documentation forapplicationgovernance.

  • Participate in audits, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity efforts.

Vendor & Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary contact for clinical application vendors.

  • Manage vendor performance, contracts, issue resolution, and service level agreements.

  • Evaluatenew technologiesand software solutions.

  • Coordinate third-party integrations with enterprise systems.

Training & Change Management

  • Support organizational change management initiatives.

  • Collaborate with education teams to develop user training programs.

  • Ensure effective communicationregardingsystem changes and upgrades.

  • Promote end-user engagement and satisfaction.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Monitor application performance metrics and key performance indicators.

  • Prepare reports for executive leadershipregardingapplicationutilization, support metrics, and project status.

  • Utilize data toidentifyimprovement opportunities and measure outcomes.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, information technology, computer science, nursing informatics, or relatedfields.

  • 5-7 yearsof progressive leadership experience in healthcare technology, clinical systems, or interoperability, with at least3years managing enterprise healthcare technology teams.

  • Experiencewith healthcare interoperability standards and integration architectures including HL7, FHIR, CCD/CCDA, and API-based integration.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale clinical technology implementations, optimizations, and interoperability initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of clinical workflows, healthcare operations, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Proven experience managing vendor relationships and enterprise technology contracts with cost and performance discipline.

  • Track record of leading cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex, multi-entity healthcare environments.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

  • Advanced degree in health informatics, healthcare administration, information technology, or equivalent.

  • PMP, CPHIMS, or CHDA certification.

  • Experience with multi-entity or integrated delivery network clinical systems governance.

Technical Fluency

  • Demonstrated technical fluency in healthcare information systems, including application architecture, interfaces, databases, and system integrations.

  • Working knowledge of interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, CCD/C-CDA, and interface engines.

  • Understanding Active Directory,identityand access management, single sign-on (SSO), role-based security, and user provisioning.

  • Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, dashboards, and data analytics to support operational and clinical decision-making.

  • Knowledge of cloud-based and on-premises application environments, virtualization, and infrastructure dependencies affecting clinical applications.

  • Understanding ofIT service management (ITIL), change management, release management, and incident/problem management processes.

  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, logs, and system performance metrics tofacilitatetroubleshooting and root cause analysis.

  • Working knowledge of APIs, web services, and application integration methodologies.

  • Understanding ofcybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, business continuity, and HIPAA security requirements.

  • Ability to communicate concepts effectively to clinicians, executives, vendors, and IT professionals.

  • Experience evaluating emerging healthcare technologies, including artificial intelligence, clinical decision support, workflow automation, and digital health solutions, for operational and clinical value

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented approach

  • Ability to assess risks, prioritize competing demands, and make sound operational and technical decisions

  • Commitment to enterprise security, compliance, and governance as foundational disciplines.

  • Ability to lead throughanalystsand specialists, building organizational capability across clinical applications

  • Commitment to innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Kettering, Ohio

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

raw.excerpt: About the roleAt Blackbaud, we believe technology can be a powerful force for social good.
raw.description:
About the role

At Blackbaud, we believe technology can be a powerful force for social good. JustGiving from Blackbaud is trusted by nonprofit organizations around the world to help them raise more money, reach new supporters, and amplify their impact through modern, social-first fundraising. JustGiving is a leading online fundraising platform built for today’s digital-first supporters. It enables charities to launch beautifully branded campaigns that include peer-to-peer fundraising, crowdfunding, and direct giving—either as a standalone solution or integrated with Blackbaud’s fundraising CRMs. JustGiving exists to turn "I care" in to "I can", helping individuals and organization make giving easy, impactful and scalable.

JustGiving is looking for an enthusiastic and driven New Business Executive to own and drive a self-generated and partner-led pipeline of high value multi-charity and single charity event opportunities. The objective of this role is to maximize donation growth, build key relationships with stakeholders, and provide strategic support using business development skills to identify, qualify and close new opportunities.

What you'll do

The success of this role will be measured by donation growth. Your responsibilities will therefore include:

  • Uncovering and driving net new event wins from competitors, securing contract partners and driving influenceable growth from existing non-profit organizations.
  • Collaborating with prospective and existing partners to maximize engagement and increase donations.
  • Building and managing a pipeline of new business activity.
  • Accurately forecasting revenue growth and identifying commercial risks.
  • Identifying new revenue streams and opportunities for wider platform adoption.

raw.description:
At Curana Health, we're on a mission to radically improve the health, happiness, and dignity of older adults—and we're looking for passionate people to help us do it.

As a national leader in value-based care, we offer senior living communities and skilled nursing facilities a wide range of solutions (including on-site primary care services, Accountable Care Organizations, and Medicare Advantage Special Needs Plans) proven to enhance health outcomes, streamline operations, and create new financial opportunities.

Founded in 2021, we've grown quickly—now serving 200,000+ seniors in 1,500+ communities across 32 states. Our team includes more than 1,000 clinicians alongside care coordinators, analysts, operators, and professionals from all backgrounds, all working together to deliver high-quality, proactive solutions for senior living operators and those they care for.

Ranked #147 on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies, we're just getting started. If you're looking to make a meaningful impact on the senior healthcare landscape, you're in the right place—and we look forward to working with you.

For more information about our company, visit CuranaHealth.com.

Summary

At Curana Health, we are committed to supporting the health, dignity, and comfort of residents in senior living communities. Our National After-Hours Call Team plays a vital role by providing compassionate telephonic care and clinical direction during evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays—ensuring that residents receive timely, high-quality support without unnecessary transfers.

In this work-from-home role, you’ll deliver after-hours care virtually (primarily by phone) to aging residents across multiple states. This position offers both autonomy and purpose—you’ll be the trusted voice and clinical partner helping residents and facility staff during critical times, making an immediate impact in the lives of older adults.

In this position the provider must be comfortable managing high call volumes and performing at least 30% telehealth visits, including evaluation of acute changes, falls, and controlled substance visits. Providers must be able to manage multiple calls independently while providing care across several states.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first line of support for residents and facility staff after-hours, providing direction and medical care over the phone.

  • Use Curana’s telephonic platform to take and place calls, coordinating care between facilities, hospitals, and clinics.

  • Deliver high-quality, cost-effective care to patients—addressing acute, chronic, and behavioral health needs in collaboration with physicians and specialty providers.

  • Perform comprehensive assessments and document encounters accurately and thoroughly in the EMR, ensuring compliance with CMS requirements.

  • Apply Curana’s clinical protocols and practice guidelines to support safe, effective treatment in place whenever possible.

  • Participate in mandatory education and training to stay current with standards of care.

Scheduling & Hours:

While shift times can vary, we provide coverage to skilled nursing and senior living facilities on weeknights from 5pm- 8am local time, continuous coverage from Friday at 5pm to Monday at 8am. Holiday coverage is also provided beginning at 5pm of the end of the last business day to 8am of the resumption of business hours.

  • Availability and Coverage expectations for this role
    • 48 hours per month with 36 of those hours on the weekends.

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

  • Master's Degree as a Nurse Practitioner
  • Current unrestricted NP license in Pennsylvania or New York. Active or willingness to obtain licensure within 30 days is required for the District of Columbia, Michigan, Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia.
  • Nurse Practitioner national certification as ANP, FNP, or GNP
  • Ability to obtain DEA licensure / Prescriptive Authority
  • Background in acute and chronic disease management
  • Clinical background in adult, family, or geriatrics
  • 3+ years of experience as a NP
  • Ability to gain a collaborative practice agreement, if applicable in your state(s)
  • Ability to work scheduled shifts in accordance with scheduling policies
  • Proficient computer skills including the ability to document medical information with written and electronic medical records

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a nursing home, or with seniors in an acute care facility
  • Understanding of Geriatrics, Chronic Illness, and acute disease management
  • Understanding of Advanced Illness and end of life discussions
  • Ability to develop and maintain positive customer relationships
  • Adaptability to change

We’re thrilled to announce that Curana Health has been named the 147th fastest growing, privately owned company in the nation on Inc. magazine’s prestigious Inc. 5000 list. Curana also ranked 16th in the “Healthcare & Medical” industry category and 21st in Texas.

This recognition underscores Curana Health’s impact in transforming senior housing by supporting operator stability and ensuring seniors receive the high-quality care they deserve.

Establishes a bespoke AMI Infinity curricula-aligned Facilitation Pathway with the HCP in pursuit of supporting improved patient outcomes. raw.description:
The Senior Business Analyst is an expert in business analysis, functional design, and web solutions. They contribute to the evolution and modernization of LGI's Human Resources (HR) and Payroll management solutions by transforming business needs into digital solutions that create value for customers and end users.

Working closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, Subject Matter Experts, and customers, the Senior Business Analyst participates in every stage of the Agile development lifecycle, from product discovery through feature delivery. They play a key role in modernizing the web components of LGI's HR and Payroll solutions by designing functional solutions that are consistent, high-performing, and user-centered.

As a subject matter expert, the Senior Business Analyst acts as a strategic partner to the Product teams. They facilitate discovery workshops, translate business needs into functional solutions, define expected application behaviors, and ensure that delivered functionality meets both business objectives and user needs.

They leverage artificial intelligence tools to improve the efficiency of business analysis, prototyping, functional design, user story creation, and documentation.

They also contribute to the evolution of business analysis practices by integrating AI tools as productivity enablers, proposing improvements to working methods, and promoting the adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Analysis & Functional Design (Approximately 65%)

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Subject Matter Experts, and stakeholders to understand, analyze, and refine business requirements.
  • Participate in Product Discovery activities, hypothesis validation, and user needs exploration.
  • Contribute to the modernization of the HR and Payroll web solutions by participating in their functional design and ongoing evolution.
  • Define user journeys, functional behaviors, business rules, validations, exception handling, and interactions between solution components.
  • Partner with UI/UX Designers to design, refine, and validate wireframes and prototypes, ensuring alignment with business requirements and the desired user experience.
  • Translate business requirements and design mockups into clear, complete user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation that are ready for development.
  • Break down features into deliverable increments and contribute to prioritization based on business value, user experience, risk, and implementation complexity.
  • Participate in the functional modernization of solutions by assessing the business, operational, and technical impacts of proposed changes.
  • Responsibly leverage artificial intelligence tools to accelerate analysis, research, prototyping, documentation, and user story development while exercising critical judgment and ensuring the quality of deliverables.

Communication & Collaboration (Approximately 25%)

  • Work closely with Product Managers to ensure the consistent evolution of the product backlog.
  • Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Facilitate discovery, validation, and solution design workshops with customers and stakeholders.
  • Present proposed functional solutions to stakeholders and obtain alignment and buy-in.
  • Communicate business requirements and proposed solutions effectively to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support development teams by answering functional questions and validating deliverables prior to acceptance.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to define test scenarios.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date functional documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support implementation and Customer Success teams during the rollout of new functionality.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement (Approximately 10%)

  • Serve as a business analysis subject matter expert within the Product organization.
  • Mentor Business Analysts and contribute to the development of their skills.
  • Contribute to the evolution of business analysis methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Promote the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence and help evolve best practices to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of business analysis activities.
  • Stay current on industry trends in business analysis, digital product design, user experience, and artificial intelligence, and recommend improvements to team practices.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of product delivery processes.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or another relevant discipline.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in business analysis or functional analysis within a software development environment.
  • Significant experience designing and delivering web-based solutions.
  • Proven experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience in user needs discovery, writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, and Quality Assurance teams.
  • IIBA certification (CBAP, CCBA, or equivalent) is considered an asset.

Knowledge & Technical Skills

  • Excellent ability to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
  • Strong understanding of modern web application design principles.
  • Good understanding of modern web architectures, REST APIs, and application integration mechanisms.
  • Experience with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Axure, or Balsamiq.
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience using, in a work related context, generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) and strong prompt engineering skills.
  • Ability to effectively integrate AI into business analysis, prototyping, functional design, and documentation activities.
  • Understanding of the opportunities, limitations, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
  • Knowledge of Human Resources, Payroll, Talent Management, or unionized work environments is considered an asset.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to integrate artificial intelligence into software products is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG) is considered an asset.

Personal Competencies

  • Inspiring and collaborative leadership.
  • Strong initiative and the ability to positively influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and workshop leadership skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and teamwork abilities.
  • Customer-focused with a user-centered mindset.
  • Systems thinking and the ability to solve complex problems.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills.
  • Self-motivated with a high sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Intellectual curiosity, commitment to continuous learning, and adaptability in a rapidly evolving technology environment.
  • Ability to challenge existing practices and drive continuous improvement.
  • Critical thinking skills to validate and enhance outputs generated by artificial intelligence tools.
  • Ability to leverage AI-driven productivity gains in order to focus expertise on high-value strategic activities.
  • Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Excellent written and spoken French is required for this position as it requires almost exclusively spoken and written communication in French. (Bilingual French and English will be considered as an asset but is not required.)

Why join LGI?

  • A workplace built on trust, autonomy and collaboration
  • The opportunity to grow, perform and work alongside curious and talented colleagues
  • A continuous learning culture with dedicated training time, a renowed skills development platform and access to cutting-edge tools
  • Stimulating projects that advance healthcare technology and support the work of over 320,000 professionals, benefiting more than 6 million patients
  • A comprehensive benefits package including group insurance from day one, a group RRSP with employer contributions, 24/7 telemedicine, an employee and family assistance program, and a minimum of 3 weeks vacation per year

At LGI Healthcare Solutions, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe that a diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds contributes to our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and respectful work environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

Interested?

Come and join us!

For over 40 years, LGI Healthcare Solutions has built software that healthcare organizations depend on. AI is now at the heart of that work — not as a destination, but as the engine behind our next generation of mission-critical solutions and our enduring mission: helping healthcare organizations perform at their best.

We're looking for exceptional people who are passionate about technology, relentless in their standards, and driven to push what's possible further.  At LGI, curiosity isn't a nice-to-have, it's how we work.

We're looking for talent who explore and innovate by instinct and want their work to matter beyond the codebase: shaping decisions, enhancing processes, and enabling healthcare practitioners.

raw.description:
Principal Global Payments PM

Location: Toronto/GTA preferred; Ottawa considered
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
Work Model: Remote within Canada

About the Role:

The Principal Product Manager - Global Payments will own the product roadmap, and execution for Veem’s global payment capabilities across pay-in, payout, money movement, partner integrations, and payment operations. This leader will define how Veem expands and optimizes payment rails, local market capabilities, partner coverage, reliability, cost, speed, and customer experience across global markets.

This is a senior, strategic product role that requires deep payments domain expertise, strong technical judgment, and the ability to partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, and external payment partners. The ideal candidate has built and scaled global payment products, evaluated and managed payment partners, and led complex integrations across pay-in and payout capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Leadership: Define and drive the roadmap, and success metrics for global payment capabilities, including pay-ins, payouts, payment methods, payment routing, settlement, reconciliation, and partner integrations.
  • Global Payments Roadmap: Identify market, customer, and operational needs across regions and translate them into scalable product requirements and prioritized delivery plans.
  • Partner Management and Evaluation: Evaluate, select, onboard, and manage payment partners and vendors based on capabilities, geographic coverage, reliability, cost, compliance posture, technical fit, service levels, and long-term scalability.
  • Pay-In and Payout Integrations: Lead end-to-end product requirements and execution for pay-in and payout partner integrations, including APIs, payment method enablement, transaction status flows, webhooks, exception handling, reconciliation, reporting, and operational readiness.
  • Payment Performance Optimization: Improve authorization/conversion rates, payout success rates, processing speed, cost-to-serve, transaction visibility, resilience, and customer experience across payment flows.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data, Finance, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver high-quality global payment capabilities that are scalable, compliant, and operationally supportable.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Regulatory Enablement: Work with Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure payment products meet regulatory, licensing, AML, sanctions, fraud, data privacy, and partner obligations across global markets.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of payment industry trends, local payment methods, cross-border payment capabilities, regulatory changes, fintech infrastructure, and emerging partner solutions.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of project management experience, including significant experience in payments, fintech, financial services, or payment infrastructure; 3+ years in a senior or principal-level product role preferred.
  • Deep understanding of global payments, including pay-ins, payouts, payment methods, acquiring, bank rails, FX, settlement, reconciliation, payment operations, and cross-border money movement.
  • Proven experience evaluating, negotiating with, integrating, and managing external payment partners, processors, banking partners, payment networks, or fintech infrastructure providers.
  • Hands-on experience leading API-based partner integrations and working closely with engineering teams on technical design, data flows, reliability, monitoring, and operational tooling.
  • Strong understanding of risk, fraud, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/KYB, data privacy, and regulatory considerations related to payment products.
  • Experience with B2B payments, cross-border payments, payment orchestration,local payment methods, banking integrations, card acquiring, ACH/EFT, wires, RTP/faster payments, wallets, or payout networks.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to evaluate partner performance, payment conversion, cost, reliability, and customer impact.
  • Excellent communication, executive presence, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate strategically while also driving detailed execution in a fast-moving environment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Flexible working hours and a remote-friendly culture
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Learning and development budget
  • A collaborative, growth-oriented engineering culture

Why Join Veem?

Shape the Future of Global Payments

You will help define how businesses move money internationally as the industry evolves toward faster, more intelligent, and more flexible payment infrastructure.

Lead High-Impact Technical Transformation

This role provides the scope and influence to drive meaningful change across architecture, engineering practices, platform capabilities, and organizational strategy.

Work on AI, Stablecoins, and Emerging Financial Technology

You will have the opportunity to move beyond theoretical experimentation and help determine how these technologies can be used in real-world financial systems.

Operate With Executive Visibility

You will partner directly with senior leadership and contribute to decisions that shape Veem’s long-term product and technology direction.

Maintain Hands-On Technical Impact

This is a senior leadership role for someone who still wants to engage deeply in architecture, systems, and technical problem-solving.

Join an Entrepreneurial Environment

Veem offers the opportunity to move quickly, challenge assumptions, introduce new ideas, and make a visible impact.

Build Systems That Matter

The systems you help design will support real businesses moving real money across borders. Reliability, speed, trust, and technical quality directly affect our customers.

Mentor and Multiply Engineering Talent

You will have the opportunity to develop senior engineers, strengthen technical leadership, and help shape Veem’s engineering culture.

Meaningful Equity Upside

In addition to competitive compensation, this role includes equity participation and the opportunity to share in the long-term value created as Veem continues to grow.

Join Veem

Veem is entering an important stage of its technical evolution.

The future of global payments will be shaped by intelligent automation, real-time infrastructure, new settlement technologies, stronger platform capabilities, and engineering teams that can turn emerging technology into trusted financial products.

As Principal Engineer, you will have the opportunity to help build that future.

You will influence how Veem’s systems are designed, how our engineering organization operates, and how we use AI, stablecoins, blockchain, and modern cloud technologies to create a stronger global payments platform.

If you are a deeply technical, forward-thinking engineering leader who wants to make a company-wide impact, we would love to hear from you.

About Expedock

We are a tech-enabled workforce augmentation platform leveraging top 1% offshore talent & cutting edge technology to enable businesses to unlock their full potential.

Who We Need

The Property Services Coordinator is a vital operational link between tenants, property owners, and third-party contractors. Working fully remotely, this role manages daily maintenance queries, coordinates reactive repairs and planned maintenance, and maintains strict statutory property compliance across our residential portfolio.

The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive problem solver with strong UK housing compliance knowledge, excellent remote communication skills, and a calm, customer-focused approach under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Repairs & Maintenance Coordination
    1. Serve as the main point of contact for tenant and landlord repair inquiries via phone, email, and property management portals.
    2. Perform basic diagnostic questioning over the phone/email to identify issue scopes before dispatching contractors.
    3. Assign works orders to approved contractors, manage trade schedules, and track jobs through to completion.
    4. Process contractor invoices and verify job completion sign-offs against quoted costs.
  2. Property Compliance & Safety
    1. Track and schedule cyclical safety inspections, ensuring 100% compliance across key statutory areas (Gas Safety/CP12, EICR, EPC, Fire Safety, and Legionella).
    2. Monitor and track reactive health and safety risks (including damp and mould cases in line with UK regulatory guidelines).
    3. Log and archive all safety certificates, O&M manuals, and work logs within the CRM system.
  3. Remote Contractor & Asset Management
    1. Source, onboard, and maintain relationships with reliable regional contractors across the UK.
    2. Ensure all contractors hold valid public liability insurance, certifications, and up-to-date compliance documentation.
    3. Conduct post-repair follow-up calls with tenants to evaluate work quality and track contractor performance KPIs.
  4. Tenancy & Administrative Operations
    1. Manage initial tenancy onboarding utility notifications (gas, electric, water, and council tax transfers).
    2. Coordinate property inventory checks, check-in/check-out reports, and end-of-tenancy maintenance works.
    3. Maintain complete, audit-ready digital files in the company’s property management software.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in UK property management, social housing, block management, or lettings coordination.
  • UK Compliance Knowledge: Solid understanding of UK residential housing regulations (Gas Safety, Electrical Safety Regulations, Awaab’s Law, EPCs, and Health and Housing Safety Rating System - HHSRS).
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable using cloud-based property software (e.g., Fixflo, Reapit, Arthur Online, AppFolio, or Yardi), e-signature tools, and Microsoft 365/Google Workspace.
  • Remote Work Setup: Dedicated, quiet home office environment with a reliable high-speed broadband connection.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with strong telephone diagnostic and conflict-resolution skills.

Technical Requirements

  • Fiber internet (PLDT Fiber, Converge, Globe Fiber, etc.) - recommended speed of 100/50 Mbps
  • Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary ISP) capable of at least 20 Mbps
  • Quiet, conducive home workspace
  • OPTIONAL: Wired Ethernet connection preferred during work hours
  • OPTIONAL: Power backup (UPS) if the location experiences frequent outages

Why Expedock

  • HMO coverage and leave creditsbecome availableafter three months of engagement.
  • Supportive Remote Environment: Work from home alongside acollaborative teamthat valuesgrowth and mutual success.
  • Structured Engagement & Training:Start strong with astructured engagement program and client-specific trainingdesigned to help you quickly master your assigned workflows.

Candidate Data & Privacy Notice

By submitting your application to Expedock, you acknowledge and consent to the collection, use, and processing of your personal information for recruitment and hiring purposes. Your information will be used to:

  • Evaluate your qualifications and suitability for current and future roles
  • Communicate with you throughout the recruitment process Improve our hiring processes and overall candidate experience
  • Maintain talent pools for future opportunities, where permitted by law

We handle candidate data with care and in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations. Your information will only be accessed by authorized team members and will not be shared with third parties without your consent, unless required by law.

About GRI

GRI is the independent global standard setter for sustainability impact reporting. GRI provides the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards and works with businesses, regulators, investors, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders to advance transparency, accountability, and sustainable development.

Through a multi-stakeholder process, GRI develops standards that reflect global best practice and public interest. With staff in more than 20 countries, we combine global perspective with local relevance, supporting long-term value creation for organizations and society.

As sustainability reporting expectations continue to evolve — including increased digitalization, AI-enabled services, interoperability initiatives, and growing demand for implementation support — GRI is expanding and modernizing how it delivers value to organizations and practitioners globally.

About the role

The Director - Commercial and Digital will lead commercial growth, customer engagement, and digital transformation across GRI’s global market-facing services, combining strong commercial leadership, digital experience, and an international perspective.

This role is focused on strengthening and scaling GRI’s portfolio of offerings, including learning and training programmes, practitioner services, digital tools, licensing, partnerships, as well as developing new products. The Director leads GRI toward a more digitally enabled, data-driven, and customer-centric operating model.

The Director leverages strong commercial leadership experience, including demonstrated success growing and scaling international services, digital platforms, or customer-facing business lines. They will understand how digitalization, strategic partnerships, AI-enabled tools, customer analytics, and user-centric service design can strengthen market reach, customer engagement, operational effectiveness, and long-term sustainability.

The role requires a leader who combines strong business acumen with collaborative leadership and a clear understanding of the evolving sustainability and reporting ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of GRI’s commercial and digital growth strategy.

  • Drive sustainable revenue growth across GRI’s portfolio of learning, training, practitioner support, and digital services.

  • Develop scalable commercial models that support both organizational impact and long-term financial sustainability.

  • Oversee global business development efforts, including strategic partnerships, channel development, customer acquisition, and expansion opportunities.

  • Identify and develop new revenue-generating opportunities, including digital services, subscriptions, platform-based offerings, and strategic collaborations.

  • Develop and oversee sales strategies, pipeline management, customer segmentation, and account growth approaches.

  • Ensure commercial activities are informed by market demand, customer insights, and measurable return on investment.

Digital scaling and innovation

  • Lead the continued digitalization and scaling of GRI’s customer-facing services and delivery models.

  • Oversee the evolution of digital platforms supporting learning, customer engagement, implementation support, and practitioner collaboration.

  • Develop and oversee a digital marketing function

  • Develop strategic digital partnerships that strengthen reach, accessibility, scalability, and innovation capacity.

  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI-enabled services, automation, analytics, personalization, and digital support tools to improve user experience and operational efficiency.

  • Drive innovation in how standards-related services and implementation support are delivered globally.

  • Ensure digital investments and initiatives are aligned with measurable customer value and business outcomes.

Sales, customer experience, and key client services

  • Oversee sales, customer success, CRM, and key account management functions across GRI’s services ecosystem.

  • Support the strengthening of client relationships, including with large reporting organizations, training partners, consultants, and ecosystem stakeholders.

  • Develop high-quality customer engagement and retention strategies focused on long-term value creation and customer satisfaction.

  • Build a data-driven and user-centric customer experience across all market-facing services.

  • Ensure customer feedback and usage data directly inform service development and prioritization.

Education, training, and practitioner services

  • Oversee and support the growth and modernization of GRI’s global portfolio of certified training programs, e-learning platforms, practitioner and community programmes.

  • Ensure programs are globally scalable, commercially sustainable, operationally effective, and responsive to market needs.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen digital delivery, accessibility, engagement, and partner-enabled growth.

Data, analytics, and performance management

  • Embed a data-driven culture across commercial and digital functions.

  • Refine KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to track commercial performance, customer engagement, digital adoption, growth, and return on investment.

  • Use customer insights, market intelligence, analytics, and performance data to support strategic decision-making and prioritization.

  • Oversee market research and competitive analysis related to sustainability reporting, digital services, customer needs, and emerging trends.

  • Support organizational agility through evidence-based planning, monitoring, evaluation and learning.

Leadership and organizational collaboration

  • Together with the team, drive the redesign of the commercial and digital function in line with future needs.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across commercial services, digital products, customer engagement, learning, and partnerships.

  • Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, growth, and continuous learning.

  • Work closely with standards, policy, communications, partnerships, finance, and operational teams to support integrated organizational delivery.

  • Deliver on GRI’s organizational strategy as a member of the Leadership Team.

Requirements

Work experience

  • Approximately 10 years of senior leadership experience in commercial, digital, business development, customer engagement, or service-oriented roles.

  • Demonstrated success scaling international digital services, learning ecosystems, platforms, subscription models, or customer-facing business lines.

  • Strong commercial acumen with proven experience driving growth, revenue development, and market expansion.

  • Significant experience leading digital transformation and digitally enabled service delivery, including digital marketing and digital platforms.

  • Experience developing and managing strategic digital partnerships and growth collaborations.

  • Proven experience leading sales, customer success, CRM, and key account management functions.

  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle management, and ROI-focused commercial performance.

  • Experience using data analytics, customer insights, and market intelligence to drive business decisions and service innovation.

  • Understanding of sustainability, ESG, reporting, disclosure, standards-setting, assurance, or related markets.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and organizational change initiatives in international and complex environments.


Knowledge and abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree required in business, technology, sustainability, management, education, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • Strong strategic and commercial mindset.

  • Demonstrated ability to scale digitally enabled services and organizations internationally.

  • Strong understanding of digital business models and customer-centric service design.

  • Data-driven decision-maker with strong analytical capabilities.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and partnership development skills.

  • Excellent leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and execution-oriented approach.

  • Ability to balance mission orientation with commercial sustainability and growth objectives.

What we offer

  • Location: Remote (candidates must have an existing valid permit to work in the location they are based)

  • Work hours: Full-time (40hrs/week)

  • Contract type: 1-year fixed-term contract with possibility for extension

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Salary: € 77,298 - € 109,505 per annum on full-time basis (Europe-based range)

  • Generous leave allowance.

  • Access to the GRI Academy.

The application deadline for this position is 10 August 2026 at 12:00 (noon) CET. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

The Sr. Rotating Controller serves as a senior finance leader responsible for providing interim and strategic financial leadership across multiple operating units, practices, or regions during periods of transition, complexity, or elevated need.

This role partners with executive leadership, physicians, and practice administrators to set financial direction, assess financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive operational and financial improvements. The Sr. Rotating Controller operates with a broad scope and high degree of autonomy and is expected to integrate financial activities across practices while influencing outcomes at the regional and enterprise level.

In addition to interim coverage, this role leads strategic initiatives, including finance transformation efforts, process standardization, onboarding and transition support for permanent controllers, and ad hoc projects spanning Accounting, FP&A, M&A, and Financial Operations.

Assignments are temporary in nature but may span multiple practices simultaneously and are focused on stabilization, optimization, and transition to permanent leadership.

Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry.
